content.text:
good morning — hope the coffee is still warm.

juno's 4-year checkup is coming up in about three weeks, a good moment to jot down any questions you've noticed lately — sleep, behavior, anything — so they're ready when you're in the room. your pediatric office can confirm the exact timing and what to expect at that visit.

nothing new surfaced locally this week, so no added noise on that front. a quiet sunday for planning, if you need one.
